reasoning: The icon shows a square clipboard or hanging sign with an exclamation mark inside, representing an incident report, inspection finding, official notice, or posted warning sign. It fits tasks centered on filing reports, answering compliance notices, or putting up warning signs, though users might misapply it to any task that simply feels 'important' (a property).
